eva (AE): Hey team — day 0 kickoff for Aperture Labs POC starts tomorrow at 10am PT. Quick sync on agenda + open risks?
raj (Solutions Eng): I can run the technical discovery. Need to confirm model variants they want and sample prompt set.
lina (Customer Success): I'll own stakeholder intros and logistics. Who is their evaluator?
tom (Security Eng): Have we received the security questionnaire? I saw an inbound PDF yesterday but haven't validated answers.
emily (Pricing): Pricing question: customer asked for a 6-week pilot with a capped spend. We should propose hosted API trial + option to convert to Dedicated. Thoughts on a soft cap number?
eva (AE): Good call — propose $5k capped for initial pilot, with committed pricing tiers outlined if they scale. Raj, can you estimate cost for 100k tokens/day typical workload?
raj (Solutions Eng): Rough ballpark on hosted: ~ $0.012/token at our mid-tier profile => 100k tokens/day ~ $1.2k/day, so $5k would cover ~4 days at that rate. But with batching + KV caching we should be way lower. Need real prompt distribution.
raj (Solutions Eng): Action: share sample prompt traffic (short Q/A vs long generation) before EOW so I can model batching impact.
lina (Customer Success): I'll ask Aperture to send 50 representative prompts across the different flows. Also confirm performance SLO expectations.
tom (Security Eng): Security blockers to flag now: SSO (SAML), IP allowlist for private deployment, and CICD secrets handling. If they require dedicated on-prem, we'll need 4 weeks lead time.
eva (AE): Success criteria we proposed: 1) qualitative correctness on 5 eval sets (>=85% agreement with ground truth), 2) p99 latency < 300ms for short prompts, 3) end-to-end feature demo with their app and < $X cost per 1k tokens. Raj/Lina — can we tighten these?
raj (Solutions Eng): Suggest swap latency to <200ms p95 for short queries; use p99 for long generations. For evals: we should run both automated reranking tests and human A/B on 20 prompts.
emily (Pricing): On the cost target, propose we articulate two scenarios: hosted pilot with capped spend and a recommended Dedicated slot estimate (monthly committed cost) so they can see delta. I'll draft numbers after Raj shares token model.
lina (Customer Success): Stakeholder list from Aperture: CTO (Priya), Head of ML (Jorge), Product Lead (Helen), Dev Lead (Marcus). Priya requested a compliance readout — Tom, can you join the kickoff?
tom (Security Eng): I'll join. Also need their SOC2 contact and any encryption/KMS requirements.
jarvis-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled "Aperture Labs POC: Day 0" tomorrow 10:00 AM PT — video link + dial-in in calendar.
eva (AE): Quick discovery questions to surface in kickoff: - primary success metric (business) - sample user flows and expected throughput - data residency/compliance needs - who approves sign-off - preferred rollback strategy if quality drops
raj (Solutions Eng): I'll bring a short runbook template for evals with prompts, metrics, and gating thresholds.
emily (Pricing): I'll share a 2-slide pricing summary pre-meeting.
lina (Customer Success): I'll chase the sample prompts and their security contact now.
eva (AE): Cool — action items: 1) Raj: token/cost model + runbook (due EOD) 2) Emily: pricing summary (due EOD) 3) Tom: compliance checklist + SOC2 ask (tomorrow) 4) Lina: prompt set + stakeholder intro (ASAP). Mark responses here so I can update the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
raj (Solutions Eng): Got it, will post the model and a short sample bash curl for on-boarding tests: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"open-rw-3b","prompt":"<sample>"}'```
eva (AE): Perfect — thanks everyone. If any enterprise blockers pop up (legal/licensing/KMS), flag immediately so sales can pause timeline rather than overpromise.
